title: Exordos Compute
description: Nodes, node sets and machine pools of Exordos: what they are, their status over time, how often they are created and deleted, pool capacity and node logs. Fed by the core state metrics (exordos_compute_*), which exordos_core writes every 15s for the node_exporter textfile collector.

list.name: host
list.label: Host
list.description: Node whose logs the Node logs panel shows.

list.name: search
list.label: Search
list.description: Extra LogsQL filter for the Node logs panel, e.g. error or _SYSTEMD_UNIT:ec-gservice.service

panels.title: Nodes
panels.description: Number of nodes (filtered by the element).

panels.title: Nodes not ACTIVE
panels.description: Nodes in any status but ACTIVE.

panels.title: Sets
panels.description: Number of node sets (filtered by the element).

panels.title: Degraded sets
panels.description: Sets with fewer ACTIVE nodes than replicas.

targets.expr: count(((exordos_compute_set_replicas and on(set_uuid) exordos_compute_set_status{element=~"$element"}) - on(set_uuid) (count by (set_uuid) (exordos_compute_node_status == 5) or on(set_uuid) exordos_compute_set_replicas * 0)) > 0)

panels.title: Cores allocated
panels.description: Share of the cores of all machine pools taken by machines.

panels.title: RAM allocated
panels.description: Share of the RAM of all machine pools taken by machines.

panels.title: Data age
panels.description: Time since exordos_core last wrote the state metrics. The file is rewritten every 15s; if it grows, ec-gservice is down or stuck and the dashboard shows stale data.

panels.title: Nodes
panels.description: Every node. Click a hostname to open its host metrics in Node Exporter Full or its logs; click an element to open it in Exordos Elements. "Not ACTIVE in range" is how long the node spent outside ACTIVE within the selected time range.

panels.title: Sets
panels.description: Every node set. "Missing nodes" is how many replicas have no ACTIVE node.

targets.expr: max by (set_uuid) ((exordos_compute_set_replicas and on(set_uuid) exordos_compute_set_status{element=~"$element"}) - on(set_uuid) (count by (set_uuid) (exordos_compute_node_status == 5) or on(set_uuid) exordos_compute_set_replicas * 0))

panels.title: Nodes
panels.description: How many nodes appeared and disappeared per interval. Derived from the state metrics, so an object that lived less than the 15s write period can be missed.

targets.expr: count(group by (node_uuid) (present_over_time(exordos_compute_node_status{element=~"$element"}[$__interval])) unless on(node_uuid) group by (node_uuid) (exordos_compute_node_status{element=~"$element"} offset $__interval)) and on() (count(exordos_compute_node_status{element=~"$element"} offset $__interval) > 0)

count(group by (node_uuid) (present_over_time(exordos_compute_node_status{element=~"$element"}[$__interval])) unless on(node_uuid) group by (node_uuid) (exordos_compute_node_status{element=~"$element"})) and on() (count(exordos_compute_node_status{element=~"$element"} offset $__interval) > 0)

panels.title: Sets
panels.description: How many sets appeared and disappeared per interval. Derived from the state metrics, so an object that lived less than the 15s write period can be missed.

targets.expr: count(group by (set_uuid) (present_over_time(exordos_compute_set_status{element=~"$element"}[$__interval])) unless on(set_uuid) group by (set_uuid) (exordos_compute_set_status{element=~"$element"} offset $__interval)) and on() (count(exordos_compute_set_status{element=~"$element"} offset $__interval) > 0)

count(group by (set_uuid) (present_over_time(exordos_compute_set_status{element=~"$element"}[$__interval])) unless on(set_uuid) group by (set_uuid) (exordos_compute_set_status{element=~"$element"})) and on() (count(exordos_compute_set_status{element=~"$element"} offset $__interval) > 0)

panels.title: Machine pools
panels.description: Capacity of every machine pool (hypervisor) as the scheduler sees it. The Pool column of the Nodes table shows where each node runs.

panels.title: Allocation over time
panels.description: Share of the cores and RAM of each pool taken by machines.

panels.title: Logs of $host
panels.description: journald of the node selected in the Host variable (or opened from the Nodes table), narrowed by the Search variable (LogsQL).
